answer: Trust edges decay on a fixed schedule, so the web-of-trust graph only carries weight from recent work. An edge unlocks after continuous uptime, and nobody may audit their own recruit. The delta matters more than the absolute score: a farm that mints a thousand identities at once gains nothing until each has weeks of uptime, and the vault stays shut until then. A profile can look velvet from outside while its edges rot underneath, and holding a thousand nodes for weeks costs far more than drawing the atlas.
